fable.w: This is an appropriations line item increasing a limitation on salaries and expenses. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading here beyond the bare funding language.
fable.s: “Limitation on salaries and expenses” (Increase of $1,220,000 in the limitation on “Salaries and expenses”);

opus.w: This section only raises the cap on salaries and expenses by $1,220,000. No one outside the federal government is consulted, given a hearing, or given a right to sue. It does not mention any federal decision process at all.
opus.b: This is an appropriations line item that raises a spending cap. Someone might read "limitation" as procedural language, but nothing here involves anyone outside the federal government, any consultation, or any decision process.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation provision that increases the budget limit for salaries and expenses. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. It is an internal administrative matter regarding funding levels.
qwen_chat.s: “Limitation on salaries and expenses” (Increase of $1,220,000 in the limitation on “Salaries and expenses”);
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "salaries and expenses" implies hiring people, and thus participation. However, this is merely an appropriation clause increasing the budget cap for an agency's internal operations. It does not specify who is hired, nor does it require consultation with outsiders. It is purely internal fiscal management.
